title: Abstracting Stream Reading
goal: Read from byte streams using the Read trait.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Morning: Standard Traits

sections.text: In other languages, byte streams rely on standard class hierarchies. Rust uses the `Read` trait from `std::io` for generic byte input.

sections.caption: `Read` takes mutable references to fill byte buffers.

sections.text: Functions taking `impl Read` accept byte slices `&[u8]`, files, and network sockets without extra allocation.
Line-by-line reading requires buffering, provided by the `BufRead` trait.

sections.caption: `BufReader` adapts any `Read` type into a `BufRead`.

sections.text: This separation keeps the base `Read` trait lean while buffering remains explicit.

explanation: Read from byte streams using the Read trait.
